title: Risk-controlled selective gating for cross-session motor-imagery BCI

task_sources.name: Conformal-BCI: conformal gating of frozen motor-imagery EEG decoders (construction prototype)
BCI Competition IV dataset 2a, Graz University of Technology (Brunner, Leeb, Müller-Putz, Schlögl, Pfurtscheller)
Lee et al. 2019, EEG dataset and OpenBMI toolbox for three BCI paradigms (GigaDB 100542, CC0)

metric.description: Coverage at target risk r = 0.20, macro-averaged: for each subject, the fraction of session-2 test trials the submission acts on, or 0 if more than 20% of the acted-on trials are wrong; averaged over subjects within each of the 10 episodes, then unweighted over episodes. Higher is better; abstaining everywhere scores 0. The authoritative result is this raw value. The linear display transform maps the always-decide bottom line 0.0833 to 0 and the THR conformal gate (alpha = 0.1) 0.1527 to 1000, without capping either end. Invalid submissions are not ranked.

baseline.name: THR conformal gate, alpha = 0.1, calibrated on session 1 (acts on singleton or empty prediction sets)
